notes.title: Godspell Defender out now!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5721558/48428b454a6888349ab86d0116627853955593cc.png[/img]

Godspell Defender is a little arcade action game designed to satisfy in short bursts.  Easy to pick up, you'll be making massive combos within no time.  Although simple, the gameplay isn't mindless.  Timing your shots to make the best combos is the only way to win.  Some combos are better than others so maximizing each shot is of paramount importance in order to win.

Out now on Steam!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5721558/68377873f078d095e40ed4fedd98b58a3bd9a3e8.png[/img]

notes.title: Patch Notes for March 15th, 2022
notes.notes: Fixed a collision issue in one of the levels resulting in the player falling through the ground.

notes.title: Patch Notes for March 15th, 2022
notes.notes: The achievement for beating level 9 was not unlocking.  This has been fixed but unfortunately we cannot unlock this retroactively because the game doesn't feature a "completion" save.  This means if you've already completed level 9 and didn't receive the achievement, you'll have to complete the level once again.  Having completed the game, it should start at level 9 until "new game" is selected.  Apologies for this and thank you for your continued support.
